title: Data Entry Keyers
description: Operate data entry device, such as keyboard or photo composing perforator. Duties may include verifying data and preparing materials for printing.

tasks.text: Locate and correct data entry errors, or report them to supervisors.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Detecting recording errors is deterministic pattern matching

dwas.name: Provide information to coworkers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Compile, sort, and verify the accuracy of data before it is entered.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Compiling data or documentation is largely automatable

tasks.text: Compare data with source documents, or re-enter data in verification format to detect errors.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Transactional data verification is rule-based and reliable

dwas.name: Verify accuracy of financial or transactional data.
Enter information into databases or software programs.

tasks.text: Store completed documents in appropriate locations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical filing and storage of records

tasks.text: Select materials needed to complete work assignments.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Resource selection needs situational judgment

dwas.name: Select resources needed to accomplish tasks.

tasks.text: Read source documents such as canceled checks, sales reports, or bills, and enter data in specific data fields or onto tapes or disks for subsequent entry, using keyboards or scanners.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Data entry into systems automatable

dwas.name: Enter information into databases or software programs.

tasks.text: Maintain logs of activities and completed work.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain operational records in structured systems

tasks.text: Load machines with required input or output media, such as paper, cards, disks, tape, or Braille media.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical operation of office machines and jams

tasks.text: Resolve garbled or indecipherable messages, using cryptographic procedures and equipment.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Translation well-handled; human reviews nuance

dwas.name: Translate information for others.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others
